description: Main entry point and widget tree setup for a Flutter application integrating with Supabase. It initializes Supabase, handles configuration errors, and displays a simple list of 'todos' fetched from the database.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: Root widget that controls the display depending on initialization state or error.

classes.name: _InitErrorScreen
classes.description: Widget displaying detailed initialization error information and guidance.

classes.name: TodosPage
classes.description: Stateful widget that fetches and displays a list of todos from the 'todos' table in Supabase.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Asynchronous main function that initializes the Flutter app and Supabase client.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Build method for MyApp widget, renders different UIs based on app state.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Build method for _InitErrorScreen, displays error details and instructions.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the state for TodosPage, starts fetching todos.

methods.name: _fetchTodos
methods.description: Fetches list of todo items from the 'todos' table in Supabase.
